scope: Development-set metric diagnostic, not a fresh causal confirmation. The causal carrier outcomes are already known; this freezes the proposed complete tensor score before computing it.
hypothesis: Contracting the target L9 value read map through Down, Left, and Right captures the complete quadratic MLP operation and ranks carrier-position causal writing better than the prior Down-only output-incidence score.
primary_metric: Frobenius norm of T[a,i,j]=sum_n (read@Down)[a,n] Left[n,i] Right[n,j], normalized by the separate Frobenius norms of read, Down, Left, and Right.
population: The same eight top/bottom MLPs per task in the source-position causal result.

predictions.pred_a_exact_tensor_replay_gauge_finiten: Library tests prove exact replay and orthogonal read-gauge invariance; all 18 task/layer scores are finite and all 16 selected component matches are unique.
predictions.pred_b_complete_tensor_improves_both_mlp: The primary normalized complete-tensor Spearman exceeds the Down-only Spearman for both has/had (0.26190476) and is/was (-0.59523810).
predictions.pred_c_complete_tensor_repairs_is_was_or: The is/was primary Spearman is positive and its top-six tensor-ranked MLPs include MLP4.
predictions.pred_d_zero_forward_development_scope: No model forward, causal evaluation, fit, backward, or update is executed.

decision: screen means the metric graduates only to prospective testing on fresh causal data; null means the static complete tensor is still insufficient and activation-conditioned factors are required; invalid on implementation, matching, finiteness, or price failure
